notes: ⚠️ CONTESTED, AND THE CONTEST IS THE DIAGNOSIS. The documentation (EVD-0006) supports it; the dev experiment (EVD-0012) refutes it. Both are applicable because the claim NAMES NO MODE — and that is the defect. The doc describes prerendering 'at build time'; the experiment ran `next dev`, where there is no build. Scoping resolves it into two claims that do not conflict: AST-0010 (build mode, source-supported, untested) and AST-0011 (dev mode, experimentally confirmed).
